verdict.rationale: Numeral exposes a broad REST API (products, calculations, transactions, refunds, refund reversals, merchants, platform calculations, certificate requests) plus an MCP server that lets an AI agent query nexus, filings, registrations, transactions, sales, products and exemption certificates, covering most core workflows programmatically. However, evidence doesn't confirm API/MCP parity for some UI-highlighted capabilities like initiating filings/registrations, virtual mailbox tax-mail handling, or autofile/autoregister actions — these appear as dashboard/product features without a documented write endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for filing and registration actions, and confirmation that mail-monitoring/autofile features are API-accessible rather than UI-only.
